info.title: API.SH: Google Patents
info.description: The Google Patents API from API.SH: public Google Patents data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A patent's citations in both directions: the patents it cites, the patents citing it, the family-to-family lists (patents cited by its family, families citing its family) and the non-patent literature it cites. Each patent row has the publication number, title, original assignee, priority and publication dates, language, link, and whether the examiner or a third party made the citation. `totals` always gives the full count of every list; `limit` and `page` page each list the same way.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-patents-citations

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The patent URL instead of `id`, e.g. `https://patents.google.com/patent/US6285999B1/en`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated lists to return: cites, cited_by, family_cites, family_cited_by, non_patent (default all).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of every list, from 1 (default 1). `next_page` is set while any list has more rows.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: page (default; the order Google Patents lists them), newest or oldest by priority date. Non-patent citations keep their order.

parameters.name: examiner_only
parameters.description: true keeps only the citations made by the examiner (totals stay the full counts).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A CPC (Cooperative Patent Classification) symbol's title, level (section, class, subclass, main group, subgroup), its parent symbols with their titles and the most relevant narrower symbols; or, with q, the CPC symbols that match some words.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-patents-classification

parameters.description: Words to find CPC symbols for, instead of code.

get.summary: Google Patents by inventor or assignee
get.description:
Every patent of an inventor or an assignee (company), newest or most relevant first: publication number, title, snippet, inventors, assignees, priority, filing, publication and grant dates, language, family size, PDF and link, with the total. Accepts the same filters as search (country, status, type, dates, CPC, sort). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-patents-inventor

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Assignee (company) name, instead of or with name.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Patent office, e.g. US, EP, WO, CN.

get.description:
One patent: title, abstract, inventors, assignee, dates, status, claims, description, events, citations, cited-by, similar documents, classifications, images and PDF. Also returns family_id, legal_status, expiration_date, other_versions, family_members (publication number, date, language), priority_claims, family_applications (with status and expiry), country_status, family_cited_by, family_citations, non_patent_citations, legal_events (date, code, title, attributes), cpc_codes (the most specific CPC codes), patent_citations_count, cited_by_count, family_cited_by_count, non_patent_citations_count and claims_structured (number, text, dependent_on, independent).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-patents-patent

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Patent search results: publication number, title, snippet, inventor, assignee, priority/filing/publication/grant dates, PDF and thumbnail. 10 per page. Each result also has inventors and assignees as arrays. Narrow by CPC class with cpc, return up to 100 results a page with num, and show one result per language version with dups=language.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-patents-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms (Google Patents syntax works, e.g. (solar) AND (tracker)).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Comma-separated office codes (US, EP, WO, CN, JP, KR, DE ...).

parameters.name: cpc
parameters.description: CPC classification symbols, comma separated (e.g. H02S20/30).

parameters.name: dups
parameters.description: family: one result per patent family (the default); language: one result per language version.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
